meta.title: WebFully — Websites, SEO and brands from Mjölby, Sweden
meta.description: WebFully is a digital studio in Mjölby, Sweden. We build websites, brands and visibility on Google and in AI search for small and medium-sized companies.

sections.label: Web & brand · Mjölby
sections.title: The missing piece
sections.lead: We build websites and brands that help small companies get seen, get remembered and grow.

intro.label: The studio
intro.title: From a blank page
intro.lead: We plan, design and build your digital presence as one whole. From the first sketch to a website that is found, recognised and brings in customers.

points.title: Your own design
points.text: No templates. Every page is drawn for your business.

points.title: Found for real
points.text: Built for Google and AI search from the very first line.

points.title: Fast everywhere
points.text: Light code that loads quickly on mobile and desktop.

points.title: Two languages
points.text: Swedish and English, with the right SEO for both.

steps.title: Structure
steps.text: We start with the foundation: what you offer, who you talk to and what the site has to achieve.

steps.title: Identity
steps.text: Then the form. Type, colour and imagery that make you recognisable at once.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Finally we publish, measure and fine-tune. The site should keep working long after launch.

sections.label: Pricing
sections.title: Two packages.
sections.lead: A simple company website with hosting, SSL and support. Ready within a week of receiving all your material.
sections.unit_year: SEK/month excl. VAT · one year paid in advance
sections.unit_month: SEK/month excl. VAT · setup fee 1 990 SEK
sections.note: All prices excl. VAT. Domain name not included.
sections.terms_year: The price is per month and the whole year is paid in advance. All prices excl. VAT.
sections.terms_month: Paying monthly has a setup fee of 1 990 SEK and a higher monthly price. All prices excl. VAT.

packages.name: Basic
packages.summary: A simple company website for those who want to get started.

groups.title: Included
items: Basic search engine settings (titles and descriptions)
One small change a month, up to 15 minutes

groups.title: Delivery and support

packages.name: Business
packages.summary: For those who need more pages and more room.

groups.title: Included
items: Basic search engine settings (titles and descriptions)
Changes each month, up to 30 minutes

groups.title: Delivery and support
items: Ready within a week of receiving all your material

addons.label: Add-ons
addons.title: Add what you need.
addons.lead: Booking, menu, price forms and more are added to your package. The price below is what you pay for the add-on.

items.name: Appointment booking
items.text: Customers book a time online. For hairdressers, massage, nails, makeup and other services.

items.name: Menu
items.text: A clear menu page for restaurants and pizzerias, up to 30 dishes. More dishes are priced separately.

items.name: Table booking
items.text: Guests book a table straight from the website.

items.name: Price form
items.text: The customer enters rooms, windows, distance or floors and gets a price. For moving, cleaning and more.

items.name: Website text
items.text: We write the text for up to 5 pages from the information you give us, so you do not have to write it yourself.

items.name: Logo
items.text: A simple logo for your website.

items.name: Extra images
items.text: On top of the images included in the package.

items.name: Extra mailbox
items.text: Basic includes 2 mailboxes and Business 5. The price applies to each mailbox beyond that.

items.name: Email setup
items.text: We create your mailboxes and connect them to your phone and computer.

items.name: Domain transfer
items.text: If you already have a domain name, we move it and connect it to the website.

items.name: Extra changes and support
items.text: On top of the minutes included in the package.

items.name: Domain name
items.text: We register and renew it for you.

addons.note: If an add-on needs a paid third-party licence, you see the licence cost before you order. You pay it. All prices excl. VAT.

custom.title: Need something else?
custom.text: Larger websites, custom design and special features are priced with you in a call or a meeting. Send a request and we will get back to you.

sections.label: Special projects
sections.title: No package fits?
sections.accent: Then we build it from scratch.
sections.lead: Larger websites, web apps, campaigns or a new identity. Special projects are planned and priced for you, one to one.
items: A tailored quote after a free walkthrough
One contact person through the whole project
Fixed price or ongoing, you choose

items.quote: Webfully understood right away what we do and how we want to come across. The website looks professional and shows our work the right way.
